title: BDG2 hospitality daily electricity extract (8 buildings)
publisher: Building Data Genome Project 2 (Miller, Kathirgamanathan, Picchetti, Arjunan, Park, Nagy, Raftery, Hobson, Shi, Meggers)
licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, as recorded in the author's hospitality-sustainability-ai repository (docs/DATA_SOURCES.md); check the licence of the exact distribution you use, as the GitHub mirror carries a ShareAlike licence file
scope: 6 food-service and 2 hotel buildings, daily electricity in kWh (days with at least 20 hourly readings), 2016-01-01 to 2017-12-31
important_limit: Buildings are at different sites, so they do not share a real feeder; only daily totals exist. Used only as real load data for the synthetic_grid real-building replication, not as operational hospitality evidence.
